messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — after rolling #4123 into staging we saw a ~12% p50 regression on qwen2.5 2048 sequences. Was expecting a slight improvement from the new kernel selector but latency climbed.
oliver: oof. any obvious diff in kernels chosen? did selector fall back to generic GEMM path?
maya: profiler dump attached by benchbot below. looks like for many batches the runtime switches from the fused-attn kernel (optimized for kv-head=64) to a fallback generic attention kernel at variable seq lengths.
benchbot: CPU profile snippet (top hot spots):
 - attention_fused_kernel_v2  37%
 - attention_generic  29%
 - kv_cache_shard_copy 15%
 - tokenizer_normalize 6%
(added small sampling for those batches where tokenization splits words)
lee: Related: noticed tokenizer changes in #4098 cause more multi-token boundary cases for CJK+emoji. more micro-batches with 1-2 very short segments.
sam: That could change the batch size distribution, pushing the selector's heuristics into choosing a kernel that's less optimal overall.
zara: Also saw a mismatch between attention heads and kv-head dims in the model config in a few checkpoints — there were some mistaken assert relaxations in loader code. If kv dim != heads*head_dim we end up remapping and routing to generic path.
oliver: Can you paste the model config snippet? maybe runtime is conservative and picks generic when kv-head dim not matching expected stride.
maya: here's the minimal repro of the config that triggered fallback:```
model: qwen2p5
hidden_size: 6144
num_attention_heads: 48
kv_head_dim: 128   # loader assumed 64 -> mismatch
rope_scaling: { type: "linear", factor: 1.0 }
use_alibi: false
```
lee: yep that kv_head_dim=128 vs expected 64 explains fused kernel not matching tile shapes.
sam: But why did this land in #4123? that PR only touched kernel selector thresholds, not loader.
maya: #4123 changed heuristic: if median seq_len < 40 and batch_count>4 pick small-tiles fused kernel. It didn't account for shape mismatches — selector now queries kernel.supports(shape) but misses when loader reports kv_head_dim different from checkpoint meta.
zara: tl;dr: two separate regressions aligned: loader relaxed kv-dim validation + selector heuristic change. Compound effect.
oliver: Plan: revert selector heuristic in staging, hard-fail on kv-head mismatch in loader, and bisect to find earliest commit where loader relaxed check.
sam: I can take selector revert (small PR). maya/lee can handle strict loader check. zara will bisect and open an issue for the loader.
lee: Also want to add a quick unit test: create a model meta with mismatched kv dims and assert loader raises ValueError. add a small perf test to ensure fused kernel still chosen for the canonical shapes.
maya: For the immediate mitigations: rolling back selector patch should recover p50 within 3 mins. deploy-bot will do staged rollback.
deploy-bot: Triggered rollback of staging to build 2026.05.18-89 (pre-#4123). Canary 1/3 started.
benchbot: After rollback canary numbers: p50 down ~10% vs prior staging, throughput recovered. Still leaving monitoring for 30m.
zara: bisect result: loader change landed in #4061 (loader: allow flexible kv_head_dim when quantized). It intentionally allowed mismatch for quantized artifacts but didn't set up remap metadata correctly.
oliver: Hmm, for quantized we can allow mismatch but we must compute a remapping transpose that preserves fused kernel layout; otherwise selector must be aware and prefer safe kernel.
sam: Short-term: strict check for non-quantized artifacts; for quantized, add an explicit metadata flag 'kv_layout_remapped=true' so selector can query it.
maya: I'll open #4132 that reverts selector heuristic + adds selector check for model.metadata.kv_layout_remapped. lee please add loader regression test in #4133.
lee: Added test skeleton in #4133, will fill in binary fixtures.
zara: Also noticed ALiBi flag toggle in some checkpoints: combination of ALiBi=true + rope_scaling linear produced small accuracy diffs in long contexts; not urgent perf-wise but worth flagging for later eval.
oliver: Good catch; create an eval ticket to run long-context lm-eval subset when rope/alibi combos change.
maya: Action items summarized: 1) #4132 revert heuristic (sam) 2) #4133 loader strict/quantized metadata (lee/zara) 3) Bisect change log (zara) 4) Add perf unit to CI that simulates CJK+emoji tokenization micro-batch (maya)
sam: I'll push the selector revert PR in next 30m, assign to oliver for review.
maya: Thanks everyone, I'll monitor staging metrics and report back. :thumbsup:
